title: The Stairway to Heaven
themeTags: God is with you wherever you go
God watches over you at night
reflectionQuestion: God promised Jacob, "I am with you wherever you go." I wonder how it feels to know that God is right beside you, watching over you, always?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Genesis 28; place under patriarchs/'Abraham & Sarah' or a new 'Jacob' grouping at registration). THE 100th WRITTEN STORY -- chosen as the milestone CAPSTONE because it IS the kid lane's emergent identity: 'God is with me / I am not alone' (feedback_kid_not_alone_thread). HAS A LONG -- earned through scenic/emotional progression (the goodbye + lonely road -> gathering dark + smallness -> the stone pillow -> the dream unfolding slowly: stairway, angels up/down, God at the top -> the gentle promise -> the awe of waking 'God was here and I didn't know it' -> the stone marker + vow -> tender bedtime benediction turned to the child), NOT padding. Backstory (the Esau deception) OMITTED -- Jacob is simply 'traveling to family far away'. Gentle bedtime register; the promise 'I am with you wherever you go / I will never leave you / I will bring you home'. Soft close ('side'/'always'). VOICE_NOAH_PATIENT (warm female voice Adam loves -- ideal tender, bedtime fit for the capstone).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”
